name: arXiv Today
author: Synapse
description: Each morning, the papers announced on arXiv in your categories, ranked by how they connect to your library (the papers they cite, shared authors, similar topics), with a + to add one. Earlier days stay for a month, and Claude can ask for them too.

settings.label: Categories
settings.description: arXiv categories or archives, comma-separated: quant-ph, cond-mat.str-el, hep-th, cs.LG …

settings.label: Include cross-lists
settings.description: Papers from other categories that are also listed in yours.

settings.label: Read reference lists
settings.description: From each paper's HTML version on arXiv, to see which of your papers it cites (one request every 3 seconds, in the background).

settings.label: Connected from score
settings.description: Papers scoring at least this count as connected to your library in the morning's notification (citing one of your papers scores 3, sharing an author with one 2).

settings.label: Tell me when new papers arrive
Keep for
settings.description: Days after which a listing is forgotten (papers you added stay in your library).
